title: Disappointing!!!
text: Disappointing!!!. I am very disappointed with this mattress.  I expected a memory foam type feel but its just like a hard regular foam mattress. It does not conform to your body.  While I don't expect a tempurpedic type feel for this much cheaper mattress, I really thought it would be half decent.  I am not sleeping any better and my pains haven't gotten any less.  I have been using this new mattress for just about one (1) month and it already has started sinking in the areas where we sleep, especially my husband's side - he is only 175lbs, I am 146lbs.  I was really looking forward to some comfort and better sleep.  I would not recommend this.

product_metadata.title: Zinus Responsive Memory Foam 10 Inch / Firm / Universal Comfort Support Mattress, Twin
features: 2 inch Viscolatex Responsive Foam, 1 inch Memory Foam, 2 inch HD Support Foam, 5 inch High Density Base Foam, with a soft luxurious cover
The foams are infused with green tea, charcoal and natural plant oil for minimal use of petrol based chemical and works to eliminate odors
Patented compression technology allows our mattresses to be compressed, rolled and shipped in a box via Fedex
All foam is CertiPUR-US Certified for durability, performance and content
Please allow 24-48 hours for the memory foam mattress to fully expand to its original size and shape
description: Experience the comfort of the new Viscolatex 10 inch memory foam mattress by Zinus. Featuring an innovative, latex-like foam that creates an incredibly responsive and durable sleep surface, this mattress provides 10 inches of foam comfort with just the right amount of bounce. The innovative foam layering system of Viscolatex with high-density memory foam relieves pressure while the two layers of high density support foam provide resilience and long lasting support. The Zinus Viscolatex 10 inch Memory Foam Mattress provides full body comfort and support so you can sleep well and wake up refreshed. Our mattresses come with a 10-year limited warranty.
